findings.text: this existing test still asserts that a placed run with an unanswerable scheduler and a dead worker record is refused, which is the superseded predicate; at aaa5ea90e3f5 it fails with DID NOT RAISE CrewError, so landing the node reddens the suite until its expectation is updated.
_record_run_directory re-implements _run_directory from reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:1409, the owner of exactly this capability.
_worker_record_shown_gone re-implements _worker_record_liveness from reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:285, and should read that owner rather than parse worker.json again.
the head-arm bullet attributes gate-head.log to revision 1af5c0733a while that log's own header records aaa5ea90e3f5, so the fragment misstates which revision it ran at.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is to make the launch guard refuse a placed reading of unknown liveness only when a recorded worker has not been shown gone, and reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1968-2012 implements exactly that predicate.
VERDICT done_when: the done-when names four cases through _prepare_attempt_records plus the never-launched case through _supervisor_spawn_worker, a logged negative control and the scoped suite delta; the manifest records gate-head.log 5 passed EXIT=0 at aaa5ea90e3f5 and baseline.log 3 failed 2 passed EXIT=1 at 085fa4606a, and both logs carry their revision and a bare EXIT= line.
VERDICT write_paths: the four declared paths are dispatch_launch.py, tests/test_a_run_not_yet_launched_is_not_refused.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches the first three and nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: the source manifest is complete and internally consistent, recording both commits, five tests, the base arm, the negative control and the two out-of-scope observations; its head-arm revision citation is carried wrongly into the fragment (see finding).
VERDICT diff: read both commits against 085fa4606a; 1af5c0733a changes _launch_refused_by to take the record and adds _record_run_directory, _record_holds_a_worker and _worker_record_shown_gone plus the new test, and aaa5ea90e3f5 adds the evidence fragment.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3369 calls _prepare_attempt_records, reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2534 calls _prepare_attempt_records, reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:4005 calls _supervisor_spawn_worker
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1995-2012 refuses a placed-unknown reading only when _record_holds_a_worker is true and _worker_record_shown_gone is false, which is the stated goal.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-head.log and baseline.log record their revisions and EXIT codes for the resolved scoped suite, but the fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/a-run-has-one-live-worker/a-run-not-yet-launched-is-not-refused.html:34 cites revision 1af5c0733a for the log whose header reads aaa5ea90e3f5.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff 085fa4606a..aaa5ea90e3 changes only reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py, tests/test_a_run_not_yet_launched_is_not_refused.py and the declared evidence fragment.
SCORE durability: 16
JUSTIFICATION durability: three of the five cases in tests/test_a_run_not_yet_launched_is_not_refused.py fail at the base arm and under the restored predicate, but :231's assert pid > 0 and the record['pid'] == pid comparison both derive from the call under test rather than an independent source.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the added helpers in reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1949-1996 follow the module's docstring and Mapping-based record handling, and introduce no plan or ticket identifier.
SCORE reuse: 4
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1949 _record_run_directory duplicates reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:1409 _run_directory and :1987 _worker_record_shown_gone duplicates reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:285 _worker_record_liveness, both owners already reachable from this module.
FINDING tests/test_a_queued_run_launches_once.py:255 blocking: this existing test still asserts that a placed run with an unanswerable scheduler and a dead worker record is refused, which is the superseded predicate; at aaa5ea90e3f5 it fails with DID NOT RAISE CrewError, so landing the node reddens the suite until its expectation is updated.
